measured_protocol_defect: The bound comparison hashed full evidence rows containing guard_check_seconds, a measured duration that is expected to differ across processes. Full-file identity therefore conflated semantic generation reproducibility with timing reproducibility.
decision: Preserve V499/V500 as a formal failure. Perform one preregistered read-only three-way field audit that permits differences only in guard_check_seconds and requires exact identity for prompt identity, generated text, completed-response token IDs, routing, guard actions, functional metrics, repetition metrics, and strong-parent identity. No new generation or training is authorized.
claim_boundary: Formal replication-gate failure with two complete quality passes; semantic reproducibility is not yet established and requires the bounded read-only audit.
